title: D-TRANS
slogan: NO KEY, FREE, 3s IN FIRST 6 SECONDS
pillars: ★BALL —> LATEST POINT OF PICKUP = 4 PT LINE OR HIGHER

terms.name: 2  BACK
terms.description: 2 guards get back (through elbows if in corner) during shot attemps to stop leak outs and head mens.

terms.name: 2  BASKET
terms.description: 2 Bigs go rebound shot. If no Oreb then must sprint back while locating match up.

terms.name: Shooter
terms.description: Can follow his shot (help rebound) or pick up ball

terms.name: SCRAM
terms.description: Pulling player out from mismatch

title: KYP CLOSEOUTS
pillars: ★ High Hands But Gap The Drive and Absorb the First Dribble

terms.name: GRIF (Blake Griffin) - SQUARE
terms.description: Shooter & Driver, C/O arm length away

terms.name: KAT - BODY
terms.description: Shooter - Close Out To the Body of Designated Shooters

terms.name: KLAY - FLYBY
terms.description: Run at the Shooting Shoulder With Shooting Hand (Right on Right) - Come back and Rear View Contest the pull up jumper.

terms.name: SHAQ
terms.description: Driver - Absorb the Drive

title: 1-ON-1
slogan: PRESSURE, GUARD THE SHELL, STAY IN FRONT W/O FOULING

terms.name: GUARD SHELL - Strong Hand Attack CHEST, Weak Hand Attack Run
terms.description: Force “Flat Drives” Outside the Blocks and Elbows.

terms.name: STICK HAND
terms.description: Early stick hand with inside hand on every closeout.

terms.name: CHEST
terms.description: Chest up to describe the act of absorbing the physical contact with your chest once you’re square. SHOW HANDS to avoid fouls.

terms.name: TRACE
terms.description: Keeping an active hand above the ball at all times to create ball pressure and reduce vision.

terms.name: VERTICALITY
terms.description: When helping from RIM on rotation, must stay vertical and show hands. Must jump when inside the RA. Stand ground outside  the RA.

terms.name: BALL
terms.description: Must point and declare ball on every catch.

terms.name: STRONG
terms.description: Defender guarding player next to ball ( not "NAIL" though) - Responsible for shrinking and stunting

terms.name: RIM
terms.description: Defender responsible for RIM HELP on attacks - Needs to learn how to stunt for help to make E2 decision harder

terms.name: LOW
terms.description: Bottom weak side defender - Responsible for Top Foot help on Rim Offensive Player on paint attack - Has 2nd Pass on "X" rotation - Low Hole defender responsible for “FIRE” help

terms.name: NAIL
terms.description: The top weak side defender — who is at the Nail- Ball Foot Up - The person who sinks on a baseline or slot drive— has 1st pass out to weak side. Stand outside paint near elbow to influence corner pass and  take away slot cuts with butt to baseline for vision of ball and cutters-----when ball gets behind you on attack, move away from mid line to prepare c/o on 1st pass

terms.name: SHRINK
terms.description: Show bodies in driving lanes and in the paint - make offensive players finish and make plays in thru multiple defenders. SHOW A CROWD by using srhinking to "BEN" (Blocks, Elbows, Nail)

terms.name: BE IN TO GET OUT
terms.description: Your BODY is pulled “IN” to help so that you can SHRINK THE FLOOR — but your MIND is intent on getting OUT to 3-point  threats.

terms.name: PIVOT & SPRINT
terms.description: When the ball moves, you sprint to help position on the ball’s airtime. Be in proper position on the catch.

terms.name: B.E.N
terms.description: Our shrink spots are the Blocks, Elbows and Nail. If you are not guarding the ball, you should be shrinking the floor.

terms.name: STUNT
terms.description: Hand and foot fake by a help defender to fake help but get back to a shooter. Stunt Up The Line.

terms.name: FIRE
terms.description: When we Rotate from “RIM” to trap the box on a baseline or slot drive outside the paint.

terms.name: SINK
terms.description: weakside NAIL sinks to centerfield on a N-S drive.

terms.name: X
terms.description: Any time we are X-ing out and doing a full rotation. When we X from the elbow to corner, we close out to the high shoulder to take away swing  pass.

terms.name: PEEL
terms.description: When a man is beat, and his hips are open below the recovery line (around free throw line), the next help defender calls "PEEL" signaling a jump or “switch.

terms.name: HIT-FIND-GET
terms.description: Our D-rebounding technique. When shot goes up, HIT (your man with a forearm), FIND (Turn, Seal & Find Ball), Get (Pursue Ball).

terms.name: SANDWICH
terms.description: When we send an extra guard defender to double team the weak side offensive rebounder. Guards - check your man — If he gets back  - then sprint to weakside.

title: PICK AND ROLL DEFENSE
pillars: ★ BIG CALLS SCREEN AND COVERAGE  EARLY, LOUD, CONTINUOUS (3X)
★ GUARD IMPACT BALL & FORCE BALL  INTO COVERAGE
★ BIG UP TO TOUCH ON SHOOTER  BASED ON THREAT LEVEL
★ BIG TAKES AWAY LOW POCKET PASS
★ GUARD TAKES AWAY HIGH POCKET &  HOOK PASS
★ WEAKSIDE NAIL IN BUT FANS OUT
★ WEAKSIDE BASE IS ULTIMATE TAG AT  THE RIM

terms.name: DROP
terms.description: MIDDLE P/R (MPR) BASE DEFENSE. Big calls “LEFT” or “RIGHT” to tell on-ball defender which shoulder the screen is targeting. Big plays centerfield in MPR (level of drop changes based on KYP). Big stabs at ball while remaining square between ball and basket. Guard forces  into the screen and works to get “BACK” in front to “SQUARE”. On flat middle ballscreens, we will force to weak hand.

terms.name: DROP
terms.description: Big zones and drops toward basket. Level of drop depends on KYP of the Big and the player on offense. First step is backwards  toward the rim. No Roller Behind. Our base level of Drop Coverage.

terms.name: FLAT
terms.description: Big at the Level - Soft Show - Stab at the ball and stay for a second. Low Hole Activated for rolls. Used against Elite 3 Point Threats.

terms.name: HOT
terms.description: Blitz = Hard double team on ball — Stay until dribble is picked up or retreat dribble. Guard forces into screen. Big traps and sprints  back to paint to find one.

terms.name: ICE
terms.description: SPR OUTER 1/3 OF FLOOR — Guard prevents ball from going middle- Chest on Shoulder. Big drops keeping BALL-YOU-RIM  relationship. If ball gets to middle, then it becomes a Drop.

terms.name: UNDER
terms.description: Get to the body, force into the screen direction, whip under and sprint ahead to get back to SQUARE.

terms.name: UPHILL UNDER
terms.description: Get to the body, force into the screen direction, whip under and sprint ahead to get back to SQUARE.

terms.name: RED
terms.description: TALK: Screener’s man calls “RED” to indicate switch. Force ball into screen to eliminate rejection TOUCH: Steer with Chest on Shoulder  TAKE: Switch up & Switch Under.

terms.name: PEEL
terms.description: Late Switch used in P/R situations when the guard cannot get back in front—takes place below PEEL Line. Also used for emergency paint switches off pins & staggers.

terms.name: PEEL VS PICK N POP
terms.description: PEEL after the ball crosses the 3 point line threshold. Guard take the popping big and big defends the ballhandler.

terms.name: SHOW
terms.description: Hard Hedge — Guard Over- Big 2 Hard Pumps and then recover with HIgh Hands. To preserve matchup. On-ball defender over or  under show based on KYP.

terms.name: SQUARE TO RED
terms.description: Used for like-size screening actions. “SQUARE” to tell the on-ball defender to square his feet. “RED” on contact. Chest on Shoulder to eliminate slips.

terms.name: SQUEEZE
terms.description: Big stays attached - Guard Under vs Pick n Pop Big & Non Shooting Guard. Used to preserve matchups when guarding pistol  throw ahead as well.

terms.name: PASS INTERFERENCE
terms.description: Making a play at the rim against a lob— meeting the player at the rim - Foul him while in the air to foul on the ground.  No open dunks or layups.

terms.name: SHADOW
terms.description: Used to explain how defender follows outside hip of Offensive Player through screens until he can get back to "SQUARE" or "PEEL

terms.name: BULLY
terms.description: Ball defender uses his strength to move O and blow up the screen.

terms.name: STAY
terms.description: Ball defender uses stays guarding his check.

terms.name: SWITCH
terms.description: Ball defender and screen defender switch checks.

terms.name: GAP
terms.description: Big Gaps. Person guarding the receiver whips under late and gets back to SQUARE with a high hand.

terms.name: CHASE
terms.description: Big in KYP Drop. Person guarding the cutter BUSTS OVER the handoff and stays attached. Force everything UPHILL & 1-WAY.

terms.name: RED
terms.description: Switch - Talk- Touch- Take with a high hand on Switch

terms.name: HOT
terms.description: Big Up to Touch - Guard and Big Trap - Low hole responsible for Dive- Big Sprints Back to Paint with high hands

title: OFF BALL SCREEN DEFENSE
slogan: PRESS UP - ONE WAY - DEFEAT  SCREENS

terms.name: CUTTER DEFENDER
terms.description: PRESS UP - ONE WAY (FORCE UPHILL) - GET THRU - GET BACK

terms.name: SCREENER DEFENDER
terms.description: OPEN UP - GET FAT- DROP - READ

terms.name: GAP
terms.description: Shoot the GAP vs Drivers ON PINDOWNS

terms.name: CHASE
terms.description: Attach and BUST OVER vs Shooters

terms.name: TOP LOCK
terms.description: Defender stays on high side and forces everything toward baseline

terms.name: RED
terms.description: Contact Switch - Talk- Touch- Take

terms.name: VEER
terms.description: Late paint switch on a bad beat.

terms.name: SHADOW
terms.description: Used to explain how defender follows outside hip of Offensive Player through screens until he can get back to "SQUARE

terms.name: WEAK
terms.description: Shade ball handler to weak hand when ball is in middle 1/3 of the floor. Away from ball, SHRINK THE FLOOR.

terms.name: SHIFT
terms.description: LOW and weak side loads to the ball early and pre-rotates to show bodies. If ball is in the outer 1/3, then on-ball defender presses up  and forces baseline to loaded D.

terms.name: HIT
terms.description: Late run and jump double team when we want to get the ball out of the hand of a perimeter player. Double comes from the loaded side— recover to paint. If in the middle of the floor, the double comes from the player’s weak hand. Recover on dribble pickup.

terms.name: SHRINK
terms.description: Show bodies in driving lanes and in the paint - make offensive players finish and make plays in thru multiple defenders. SHOW A CROWD by using srhinking to "BEN" (Blocks, Elbows, Nail)

terms.name: GOLD
terms.description: 3/4 Top Denial —Base Post Defense. Slide behind on the pass. Wall off the shot and show hands to avoid fouls.

terms.name: NO MIDDLE - Sit on inside shoulder
terms.description: to take away middle 1-on-1 in the post— Feet pointed to the sideline but square.

terms.name: DIG HELP
terms.description: Shrink on the catch - Dig with closest man on the bounce. Butt to the baseline.

terms.name: WHITE TO FIRE
terms.description: Front the Post with Weakside Shift & Ball Pressure. Fronting defender yells “WHITE-WHITE-WHITE” 3 times to alert help side.

terms.name: WHITE- SCRAM
terms.description: SCRAM” switch with big on weakside. Big yells “SCRAM” telling the fronting guard to release to weakside corner.

terms.name: DIG TO HIT
terms.description: Trap on the first dribble with the nearest defender in the scoring area.

terms.name: BLACK
terms.description: 3/4 Top side Deny with an immediate base trap on ball’s air time into the post.

terms.name: HIT
terms.description: EOQ double team hot player

terms.name: CHOP - INTENTIONAL FOUL
terms.description: we will foul when up by 3. Or at the end of a quarter when there is a foul to give.

terms.name: EOG UP 2
terms.description: STAY BEFORE- SWITCH AFTER” No switches before inbound (to eliminate slips and early mismatches). Switch everything after  inbounded.

terms.name: EOG UP 3
terms.description: SWITCH BEFORE AND AFTER” Switch all screens before inbound and after inbounded. Chop when possible to avoid allowing the 3  point shot.

terms.name: UOB DEFENSE
terms.description: Inbound defender PROTECTS BASKET & TRACKS for 2 seconds at basket and then 2 seconds to strong side corner. With butt  to baseline and vision of ball - Force everything uphill. Everyone gets to the body and wars over all screens- no switches.
